_note: AI scan: Gemini and ChatGPT search the web once a day with the questions below. Answers are candidates only; the Claude runs verify them. Keys come from the GitHub secrets GEMINI_API_KEY and OPENAI_API_KEY. Set enabled to false to switch a provider off. Change the model names here if a provider renames its models.
extra: Give extra weight to events in Sweden, Norway, Finland, Denmark, Iceland and the Baltics, and to startups and scale-ups. Include setbacks (bankruptcies, cancelled projects, delays) as well as successes.

groups.name: AI and robotics
groups.focus: artificial intelligence (foundation models, AI agents, edge AI, computer vision), robotics and humanoids, autonomous vehicles and robotaxis, industrial AI

groups.name: Compute, chips and connectivity
groups.focus: semiconductors and chip export controls, quantum computing and quantum sensing, photonic and neuromorphic computing, AI data centres, 5G/6G, satellite direct-to-device, cybersecurity incidents and regulation (NIS2, Cyber Resilience Act)

groups.name: Energy, batteries and powertrain
groups.focus: batteries (solid-state, sodium-ion, recycling), electric trucks and megawatt charging, hydrogen and electrolysers, grids, energy storage, district heating, small modular reactors and fusion

groups.name: Materials, manufacturing and supply chains
groups.focus: critical minerals and rare earths, green steel, additive manufacturing, factory investments and closures, tariffs and trade conflicts affecting industry

groups.name: Defence, space and sensing
groups.focus: defence technology and counter-drone, launch vehicles and satellites (Esrange, Andøya, SaxaVord), earth observation, GNSS jamming and spoofing, lidar and radar

groups.name: Health, finance and the built environment
groups.focus: medical devices and AI diagnostics, digital finance (digital euro, stablecoins, tokenisation), construction robotics and smart buildings, public-sector technology
